# Instagram Contest Official Rules

## **Instagram #escapeindoors Contest 2020 Official Rules**

**Boy Scouts of America**

**Instagram Contest Official Rules**

**NO PURCHASE NECESSARY TO ENTER**

> Eligibility: Entrants must be legal residents of the United States to enter
> the Instagram Contest” (“Contest”). Entrants must be 13 years of age or
> older at the time of entering. Employees of Boy Scouts of America (the
> “Sponsor”), its affiliated companies, subsidiaries, retailers, suppliers,
> vendors, sales representatives, distributors, advertising agencies,
> promotional suppliers, and their parent companies, agents, officers,
> directors, and the members of the immediate families and/or persons living
> in the same household as such individuals, of each of the foregoing, are not
> eligible to enter the Contest.
>
> VOID WHERE PROHIBITED.
>
> Contest Period: This Contest begins on 09/30/2020 at 7:00 PM EDT and ends on
> 10/30/2020 at 11:59:59PM EDT (“Contest Period”). Boy Scouts of America and
> affiliates will announce winners at the end of the contest period. Sponsor’s
> computer, or its third-party service provider’s computer, is the official
> timekeeping device for the Contest.
>
> How to Enter:
>
> (a) ENTER VIA THE BOY SCOUTS OF AMERICA INSTAGRAM PAGE: Enter via the
> official Instagram account for the Boy Scouts of America at
> <https://www.instagram.com/boyscoutsofamerica/>, and completing all required
> actions.
>
>   * Tag your best Scouting picture with @boyscoutsofamerica
>   * Follow @boyscoutsofamerica
>   * Tag your pictures using #escapeindoors
>

>
> Entries containing false or fraudulent information will be disqualified.
> Unlimited entries per person per day regardless of the form of entry. Odds
> of winning depend on number of eligible entries received during the Contest
> Period. Entries remain the property of Sponsor and will not be returned or
> acknowledged.
>
> Each Contest entry must be the original creation of each entrant and must
> not contain any pre-existing, third party content. Third party content
> includes and is not limited to trademarks, brands, logos, images, visual
> effects and/or images that are not the property of the entrant. Each entry
> must be unique and not infringe the rights of any third party.
>
> Entries that include offensive content, commercial content that promotes
> anything other than the products or services offered by the Sponsors or have
> been published prior to or during the Contest Period will be disqualified at
> any point during the Contest Period at the sole discretion of the Sponsors.
> The Sponsors reserve the right to remove and/or report any inappropriate
> images for any reason.
>
> Contest entries must not contain content: where any persons are depicted to
> have taken excessive risks; that is inappropriate, indecent, obscene,
> violent, hateful, tortuous, defamatory, slanderous or libelous; that
> promotes racism or hatred against any group or individual or that promotes
> discrimination based on race, sex, religion, nationality, disability, sexual
> orientation or age; or that is unlawful, in violation of or contrary to the
> laws or regulations in the state or province where the photo was captured,
> produced or edited, as well as the laws and regulations of the United
> States.
>
> All information collected through entry into the Contest will be used only
> in accordance with Sponsor’s privacy notice at:
> <https://www.scouting.org/legal/privacy-policy/>
>
> Prizes:
>
> Three winners will be chosen for each week of the contest. Each winner will
> receive a $50 gift card to <https://www.scoutshop.org/>.
>
> General Conditions:
>
> All Federal, state and local laws and regulations are applicable. All taxes
> (including, but not limited to, income taxes), and any and all service
> charges or fees applicable to the prize are the sole responsibility of the
> winners. The prize winners may be required to execute (and have notarized)
> an Affidavit of Eligibility, a Liability Release, and a Publicity Release
> (“Affidavit/Release”) which must be returned to and received by Sponsor or
> its third-party service provider within ten (10) days from winners’ receipt
> of the Affidavit/Release. The winners may also be required to complete a
> Form 1099 before receiving their prize(s). The prize winners may also be
> required to send Sponsor appropriate proof of age. Any failure to comply
> with the foregoing will result in disqualification and an alternate winner
> may be chosen. Return of the prize, the prize notification, or the
> Affidavit/Release as undeliverable will result in disqualification and an
> alternate winner will be selected. The winners’ entry into the Contest
> and/or acceptance of the prize constitutes permission for Sponsor and its
> affiliates to use the winners’ name, address (city and state), the submitted
> photo and/or video, and/or likeness for advertising and trade purposes
> without further compensation, worldwide and in perpetuity, in any and all
> forms of media, now known and hereafter devised, including without
> limitation in Sponsor’s newsletters, on the Sponsor’s website located at
> [www.Scouting.org](https://www.scouting.org/), or Sponsor’s Facebook page at
> <https://www.facebook.com/theboyscoutsofamerica/>. All entrants agree to
> comply with these Official Rules. Any person attempting to defraud or in any
> way tamper with this Contest and any person who does not comply with these
> Official Rules, will be ineligible for the prize and may be prosecuted to
